newsitem.title: USA: ISS backs Trump Hotels, Trump Castle merger.
newsitem.headline: ISS backs Trump Hotels, Trump Castle merger.

text.p: Independent proxy analysis group Institutional Shareholder Services said on Wednesday it recommended shareholders vote for the proposed merger of Trump's Castle into Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc.

"Based on the strategic fit of the Castle into the Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts, the potential cost savings and synergies associated with the transaction, and the fairness opinion rendered by Salomon Brothers (financial advisors for the transaction), we believe the merger agreement warrants shareholders' support," the group said in a report.
Institutional Shareholder was quoted as saying in its report that most industry analysts favored the merger because it combined Trump's gaming operations.
"The combination will make Trump Hotels one of the largest casino entertainment companies in the United States," the group said.
Institutional Shareholder said it also recommended shareholders approve the proposed increase in authorized shares from 50 million to 75 million.
